📺 Eternally Yours (2026–Present)

Eternally Yours follows Charles and Liz, a married vampire couple who have spent 500 years together and are beginning to discover that eternal love isn’t always as romantic as it sounds. Living in modern-day Seattle with their eccentric vampire family, the couple has fallen into a predictable routine filled with arguments, frustrations, and the challenges of maintaining a relationship that literally lasts forever. Their lives take an unexpected turn when their daughter Emma introduces her human boyfriend, Max, bringing new complications and hilarious situations into their supernatural household. As the family navigates unusual relationships, generational differences, and the difficulties of living among humans, Charles and Liz begin questioning what it truly means to love someone for eternity. Starring Ed Weeks, Allegra Edwards, Jaren Lewison, and Helen J Shen, the series combines supernatural comedy, family drama, and heartfelt moments.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Supernatural • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 6.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 20–22 minutes per episode • TV-14

📺 Seasons: 1

🎥 Creators: Joe Port & Joe Wiseman

📺 Where to Watch: CBS and Paramount+ in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Eternally Yours is an American sitcom created by Joe Port and Joe Wiseman. It premiered on CBS on October 8, 2026. The single-camera family comedy follows a married vampire couple in Seattle, played by Ed Weeks and Allegra Edwards, whose relationship has stagnated after five centuries together.
